title: Horned Figure with Cherry Tree
description: A horned female figure with a starry dark blue body sits on a large green tree stump. Her right hand holds a bubble showing two silhouetted people under a moon while pink liquid drips from her fingers onto the stump and into a dark pool below.
prompt: a horned female figure with a starry dark blue body sits on a large green tree stump that has pink liquid dripping down its sides. a large cherry blossom tree with pink flowers grows from the stump and extends across the top of the image. her right hand holds a round bubble that shows two silhouetted people standing together under a full moon at night. more bubbles float nearby. a black bird flies above. pink petals fall through the air. the background is a dark swirling night sky. the scene has a reflective pool of dark liquid at the bottom.
